name: Otome ga Tsumugu Koi no Canvas ~Futari no Gallery~
original_name: 乙女が紡ぐ恋のキャンバス ～二人のギャラリー～
source:
This is the fandisc for Otome ga Tsumugu Koi no Canvas. It features after/another stories for the top 5 in the character poll: Rena, Chiharu, Shizuku, Yuki and Akie.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/11/01/november-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《少女编织的恋爱画布》的Fan Disc。收录了角色投票前五名的后日谈/另一个故事：丽奈、千遥、雫、雪和秋江。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/11/01/november-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
